unit.text: LLM-as-a-judge is not reliable and you should not depend on it to evaluate outputs.
unit.raw_quote: Do not trust an LLM to grade another LLM — the judge is unreliable and you should not depend on it.

candidates.statement: LLM-as-a-judge is reliable enough to depend on for evaluating LLM outputs.

sources.quote: And it works surprisingly well. Just remember that your LLM judge is like a small machine learning project in itself and it also requires some tuning and evaluation.
sources.statement: LLM-as-a-judge works surprisingly well, but the judge itself is like a small ML project that requires its own tuning and evaluation.

status_history.reason: stated in the ingested evals talk
